exercises.question: Which sentence is a future prediction? [¿Cuál es una predicción futura?]
options: La sociedad cambiará mucho. [Society will change a lot.]
La sociedad cambió mucho. [Society changed a lot.]
La sociedad cambia mucho. [Society changes a lot.]

exercises.sentence: Probablemente ___ nuevas profesiones. (haber) [There will probably be new professions.]

exercises.english: If we had more information, we would decide better.

sentences: Si cambiara la sociedad, tendríamos que adaptarnos. [If society changed, we would have to adapt.]
Si hubiera menos recursos, habría más problemas. [If there were fewer resources, there would be more problems.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines necessity and the subjunctive? [¿Cuál combina necesidad y subjuntivo?]
options: Es importante que aprendamos nuevas habilidades. [It is important that we learn new skills.]
Es importante que aprendemos nuevas habilidades. [It is important that we learn new skills.]
Es importante aprenderíamos nuevas habilidades. [It is important we would learn new skills.]

exercises.sentence: La ___ hace difícil saber qué ocurrirá. (incertidumbre) [Uncertainty makes it difficult to know what will happen.]

exercises.english: There will probably be more changes.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates the unit? [¿Cuál integra mejor la unidad?]
options: Probablemente habrá cambios, y es importante que nos preparemos para diferentes escenarios. [There will probably be changes, and it is important that we prepare for different scenarios.]
Habrá cambios. [There will be changes.]
El futuro existe. [The future exists.]

exercises.sentence: Es posible que la sociedad sea diferente.
options: It is possible that society will be different.
Society is certainly identical.
Society cannot change.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera menos recursos, habría más problemas.
options: If there were fewer resources, there would be more problems.
There will be fewer resources.
There were fewer problems yesterday.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que nos preparemos para diferentes escenarios.

options: Prepararnos para diferentes posibilidades. [Prepare for different possibilities.]
Ignorar todos los cambios. [Ignore all changes.]
Esperar hasta ayer. [Wait until yesterday.]
Probablemente habrá nuevas formas de trabajo. [There will probably be new forms of work.]
Probablemente ocurrió ayer. [It probably happened yesterday.]
Probablemente no futuro. [Probably no future.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué harías si los cambios fueran muy rápidos?

options: Me adaptaría y buscaría nuevas habilidades. [I would adapt and look for new skills.]
Me adapté mañana. [I adapted tomorrow.]
Me adaptaré ayer. [I will adapt yesterday.]

exercises.question: Which statement best combines prediction and preparation? [¿Cuál combina mejor predicción y preparación?]
options: Aunque no sabemos exactamente qué ocurrirá, es importante que nos preparemos. [Although we do not know exactly what will happen, it is important that we prepare.]
Sabemos exactamente qué ocurrirá. [We know exactly what will happen.]
No necesitamos prepararnos nunca. [We never need to prepare.]

template.prompt: Give a prediction and explain how society should respond.
template.answer: Probablemente habrá cambios importantes, por eso es necesario que la sociedad se prepare.

template.prompt: Write a short argument using prediction, probability and hypothetical language.
template.answer: El futuro es incierto, pero probablemente habrá cambios. Si fueran rápidos, tendríamos que adaptarnos, por lo que es importante que nos preparemos.
